scenarios.title: Design review
scenarios.summary: Propose a checked design-review document for human review, without implementing the design.

scenarios.title: Issue intake
scenarios.summary: Graduate dependency-unblocked GitHub issues to eligibility without granting approval or invoking a model.

scenarios.title: Issue triage
scenarios.summary: Collect a bounded read-only diagnosis and escalate the classification to a human.

scenarios.title: Customer feedback
scenarios.summary: Separate feedback assessment from a human-approved bug-fix assignment.

scenarios.title: Failing-test repair
scenarios.summary: Reproduce a failing test, attempt bounded repairs, and require deterministic checks before publication.

scenarios.title: Multi-repo fix
scenarios.summary: Read an explicitly pinned public contract from a second repository while changing only the primary.

scenarios.title: Azure DevOps
scenarios.summary: Select approved Azure DevOps bugs with native WIQL and verify a proposed .NET fix.

scenarios.title: Local SDK factory
scenarios.summary: Start from a blocked qualification guard; enable a real local factory only with reviewed runtime and provider identities.

scenarios.title: Cloud automation
scenarios.summary: Inspect an existing experimental cloud automation before any explicitly authorized, acceptance-only submission.

scenarios.title: Recurring maintenance
scenarios.summary: Reconcile open approved maintenance work with concurrent evidence checks, not a cron language.
